question: Where is Bhimrao Ambedkar Multipurpose Stadium situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Faizabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar International Sports Stadium,** located on the **Ayodhya-Sultanpur road** in the **Ayodhya district of Uttar Pradesh,** India, is a versatile facility designed to accommodate various sports and activities.
 
• It forms a key component of a large-scale project aimed at developing a sports complex in the region.
 
• Situated near the intersection of **NH-330 **and the Ayodhya ring-road, just a short distance from Ayodhya Airport, the stadium adheres to international standards.
 
• It is equipped with amenities such as a multipurpose hall and a swimming pool, making it one of the premier sports venues in Uttar Pradesh. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar, **born on April 14, 1891, and passed away on **December 6, 1956, **was an eminent Indian figure renowned for his roles as a jurist, economist, social reformer, and political leader. 
 
• He chaired the committee responsible for drafting the Constitution of India during the Constituent Assembly debates and later served as the Law and Justice minister in Jawaharlal Nehru's inaugural cabinet. 
 
• Ambedkar's influence extended to inspiring the Dalit Buddhist movement following his decision to renounce Hinduism. In recognition of his contributions, he was posthumously honored with the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award, in 1990. 
 
• His followers pay homage to him with the salutation "Jai Bhim" (meaning "Hail Bhim"), while he is affectionately referred to as Babasaheb, signifying "Respected Father".
